title: Find like, accent fold
notes: findLike (zegadb/zega#98) normalizes to NFD and drops combining marks, so the plain-ASCII cafe finds Café.

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#98: the pinned engine (a0dd28e) has no findExact/startsExact/endsExact or findLike/startsLike/endsLike; the old findWith/startsWith/endsWith spelling still parses as before.

observed.stderr:
error: expected a comparison after name
  schema:14:14
    Place(name findLike "cafe") { name }
               ^^^^^^^^
  help: use `=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `<>`, `findWith`, `startsWith`, or `endsWith`
